# chore(hfp-019): resolve the vite-plugin-pwa peer conflict

## Task

`vite-plugin-pwa` (`^1.2.0`) declares a peer range that doesn't include Vite 8, so `npm install` needs `--legacy-peer-deps`. The plugin isn't configured in `vite.config.ts`, and `workbox-window` isn't imported anywhere in `src/`. Since ADR 0001 the app is hosted first, so offline support is no longer a goal in itself.

Either remove both packages, or upgrade to a version that supports Vite 8 and configure it on purpose. Removing them is the suggested default.

## Parent Story

Pre-existing breakages (found 2026-10-26).

## Blocked by

Nothing.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `npm install` works without `--legacy-peer-deps`.
- [ ] If removed: `vite-plugin-pwa` and `workbox-window` are gone from `package.json` / lockfile, and CLAUDE.md's "Placeholders" note no longer mentions them.
- [ ] If kept: a version that supports Vite 8, configured in `vite.config.ts`, with the reason recorded.
- [ ] `npm run build` and `npm run code-quality` pass.

## Suggested label

`ready-for-agent`
